notes.title: 1.1.7 Arena Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
[h3]GAMEPLAY[/h3]
[list]
[*] ONSLAUGHT MODE - After wave 5 enemies will spawn from random Arena entrances
[/list]

[h3]OPTIMIZATION[/h3]
[list]
[*] FOOT EFFECTS - Footstep effects are now culled for offscreen dinosaurs to help reduce overall number being created at large dinosaur numbers
[/list]

[h3]BUG FIXES[/h3]
[list]
[*]ONSLAUGHT - At larger wave numbers dinosaurs were getting stuck in caves, this *should* be fixed now
[*] FALLING UNDER FLOOR - Added a safety check for dinosaur falling beneth the map that will bring them back to ground level
[/list]

notes.title: v1.1.3 AI Reworks and Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
[h3]AI[/h3]
[list]
[*] THREAT CHANGES - Dinosaurs will now respond to nearby dinosaurs that bump in to them even if they are already in combat, often changing targets to deal with the closer proximity threat
[/list]
[list]
[*] CONSUMING FLESH - After killing an opponent dinosaurs will now eat nearby dead bodies and restore health when no immediate threat is nearby
[/list]

[h3]DINOSAURS[/h3]
[list]
[*] SHANTUNGOSAURUS - Reworked its stats, animations, camera values and audio to better fit its new size
[/list]

[h3]ARENAS[/h3]
[list]
[*] ALL - Hopefully much better pathfinding in all levels including not getting stuck in the arena entrances or outskirts
[/list]

[h3]BUG FIXES[/h3]
[list]
[*] COMBAT - Charging AI animals were not calculating their headbutt damage and stun values correctly making them extremely weak, expect to much stronger AI chargers
[/list]
[list]
[*] SHORESIDE - Distant mountains were not rendering correctly
[/list]
[list]
[*] HEADBUTTS - Headbutts now also send downed dinosaurs flying, they were having no effect before
[*] AI - I think I found the reason dinosaurs were just repeatedly attacking ghosts (biting at air) and fixed it
[/list]

notes.title: v1.1.0 Performance Improvements + Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
[h3]OPTIMIZATIONS[/h3]
[list]
[*] BONES - Number of bones spawned is now capped to prevent bogging down the game in long matches.
[*] DINOSAURS - Improvements to dinosaurs to improve performance when using maximum numbers allowed in spectator mode
[*] GPU - Improvements to under the hood UE rendering, especially on the denser foliage maps.
[*] PARTICLES - Move more particles over to the GPU to reduce their bogging down the game.
[*] ARENAS - Hand combed through arenas to remove clipping and unnecessary foliage to further improve ease of rendering.
[/list]

[h3]GAMEPLAY[/h3]
[list]
[*] DODGE - Dodging now aligns with your camera to make more purposeful movements and better keep track of your dinosaurs orientation
[*] PARTICLES - Mouth blood now inherets it's velocity from the dinosaurs head creating more realistic splattering effects
[*] IMPACT PARTICLES - Impact particles now implemented on all levels
[/list]

[h3]DINOSAURS[/h3]
[list]
[*] YANGCHUANOSAURUS - Improved Head Movement and fixed offset jaw
[*] ALLOSAURUS - Improved Head Movement and fixed offset jaw
[/list]

[h3]BUG FIX[/h3]
[list]
[*] EATING WEAPONS - No more infinitely eating weapons to gain health.
[*] GENEREAL - Fixed various small errors and warnings
[/list]

notes.title: 1.0.5 Patch Notes: QoL Arena Bounds + Nav Improvements
notes.notes:
[h3]GAMEPLAY[/h3]
+ Pathfinding altered to hopefully reduce dinosaurs getting stuck in rocks and other odd places in the maps

+ Re-made the invisible walls that keep dinosaurs in the arena to hopefully eliminate dinosaur getting stuck outside the ring or inside the entrance tunnels

[h3]DINOSAURS[/h3]
+ Compy added a better clinging animation and improved physics, hopefully reducing incidents of falling through the ground

+ Protoceratops received a large buff to it's headbutt damage and stun as well as a moderate buff to its basic attack

+ Sarcusuchus got a massive health buff


[h3]BUG FIXES[/h3]
+ Insect eating had a glitch causing it to miss a LOT, it should be WAY easier to eat insects now

[h3]AI[/h3]
+ Small efficiency improvements

notes.title: 1.0.2 Patch Notes: Attack Patterns
notes.notes:
[h2]GAMEPLAY[/h2]
+ Major rework of the basic attack to unique patterns per species. Attacks are now grouped into combination patterns ending in a stronger attack
+ Stunned dinosaurs are now able to be picked up while still alive when they are in their VULNERABLE state
+ Made all dinosaurs able to carry atleast one CLINGER (dinosaur who has pounced on it) to stop animals from just instantly falling over
+ Fixed some faulty code that was making the Compy an absolute chore to beat.

[h2]DINOSAURS[/h2]
+ Reduced Yangchuanosaurus, Suchomimus, Spinosaurus, and Giganotosaurus size by 10%

[h2]BALANCE[/h2]
+ Full rebalancing of all dinosaurs due to base mechanic change
Smaller dinosaurs were the primary recipients of a buff from the basic attack rework, having lower cooldowns and longer patterns allowed me to increase their overall damage output while maintaining their lower base damage befitting their small size
+ Increased Deinocheirus basic attack damage by 30%
+ Greatly increased damage done by headbutts on PRIMARY headbutters like Pachy, and Parasaur, as that should be their main source of damage (not just stun)

[h2]AUDIO[/h2]
+ Shortened Dimetrodon's attack sounds
+ Reduced Yangchuanosaurus attack volume 20%


[h2]AI[/h2]
+ Increased difficulty with use of the Attack Patterns. More punishing for not getting out of the way once the pattern starts

notes.title: Update 1.0.1: Small QoL Changes
notes.notes:
Gameplay:
+ Reworked Arena entrances to block all dinosaurs from re-entering once they've left, this should prevent fights from ending up in the dark fog
+ Widened Arena entrances to prevent larger dinosaurs from getting stuck
+ Ascension: Anky, Dime, and Sarc falling through the map on hatch fixed

Dinosaurs:
+ Straightened Sarcosuchus basic attacks to be more accurate 

Balance:
+ Nerfed the Styracosaurus by 10% across all values.

Audio:
+ Lowered Dimetrodon vocalizations by 20%
+ New Sarcosuchus attack sounds

UI
+ Fixed blurry text on the Character Select screen
+ New Font and Sizing for Input Icons to make them more readable
+ Scroll Wheel and Right Joystick will now rotate your Dinosaur in the Character Selection screen
+ Click your Dinosaur in the Character Selection screen will take bites out of them
+ Added a button mash indicator for getting up faster and shaking off Clingers
